visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler with long dark hair, wearing a yellow-and-black striped short-sleeved shirt and light-colored patterned shorts, is shown from behind. She is pushing a white plastic step stool through a doorway into a bedroom with light wood flooring. (2) The child positions the stool against a white storage unit/cabinet. She carefully climbs the two steps to reach the top surface, where various baby items and a blue bucket hat with yellow giraffe-like horns are visible. (3) The child grabs the blue hat and places it on her head. The camera moves closer for a face-to-face shot. She smiles broadly at the camera, showing a few teeth, and gestures with her hands while talking excitedly. (4) Sitting on the edge of a white bed, the child continues to interact with the person filming. She briefly touches the hat on her head before eventually taking it off and placing it back near the cabinet area. (5) A pink animated screen appears featuring a cartoon character and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE,' concluding the clip with a bright and cheerful graphic representation.
